text: Friedman taught how to make a long key from one remembered word: write the alphabet several times into a grid as wide as the word, copy the columns out in the word's alphabetical order.
Every column order a dictionary word gives, the standard or KRYPTOS alphabet repeated 1-8 times, every starting letter, eight tables; all 24 known letters must agree.
Nothing fits K4 or any scrambled copy in 2.45 billion settings; planted texts are found. F11.4 closed.
